faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in San Carlos?
faq.answer: San Carlos homeowners typically invest $6,500 to $15,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–15 windows. This well-established Peninsula community — known as the City of Good Living — features attractive 1950s–1960s ranches and two-stories in neighborhoods like Devonshire and White Oaks. Single window installation starts at approximately $570.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in San Carlos?
faq.answer: Yes. San Carlos requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of San Carlos Building Division on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in San Carlos?
faq.answer: For San Carlos's established Peninsula market, we most frequently install Milgard Tuscany vinyl for cost-effective replacements, Andersen 400-Series for homes where interior wood aesthetics are desired, and Milgard Ultra fiberglass for hillside homes with Bay views.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all San Carlos neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all San Carlos neighborhoods including Devonshire, White Oaks, Howard Park, and Crestview Park. Zip code: 94070.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in San Carlos?
faq.answer: Most San Carlos projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
